flagship_applications.name: Jaspilite
flagship_applications.legacyMigrationNote: Jaspilite supersedes FDS's earlier Forge Control product branding as the primary autonomous development and orchestration identity. Historical Forge Control records remain preserved at /projects/forge-control.

operatingModes.name: Auto
operatingModes.label: Adaptive Orchestration
operatingModes.summary: Automatically selects eligible models and dispatches bounded planning, coding, debugging, and verification tasks across connected providers according to task complexity and user-configured rules.
operatingModes.governance: Human approval gates remain enforceable for workspace writes, shell execution, and route selection.

operatingModes.name: Meld
operatingModes.label: Multi-Agent Collaboration
operatingModes.summary: Coordinates multiple specialized agents in parallel across independent repository surfaces, synthesizing architecture review, implementation, and test verification inside one shared session state.
operatingModes.governance: Explicit file-ownership boundaries and conflict prevention govern concurrent work.

operatingModes.name: Solo
operatingModes.label: Focused Single-Model Control
operatingModes.summary: Pins a development session to one explicitly chosen local model or verified customer-provided API route for predictable, transparent step-by-step engineering without automated multi-agent switching.
operatingModes.governance: Direct developer control over every prompt turn, diff, and tool call.

providerTiers.detail: Connect locally hosted open-weight models (e.g., OpenAI-compatible local runtimes) running directly on developer hardware with zero external token egress.

Customers connect their own AI provider API keys and pay their chosen provider directly under that provider's own billing, terms, and rate limits. FDS does not route consumer subscriptions through Jaspilite, does not include an AI provider with Jaspilite, and does not offer unlimited AI inference.
Specific third-party provider API integrations are listed as verified on this site only after public end-to-end execution testing and provider-terms compatibility confirmation.
Additional CLI agents and cloud model API gateways under active engineering investigation; never implied to represent official vendor partnerships or bundled inference.

flagship_applications.name: Forge BattleVerse
flagship_applications.category: Fictional Intelligence, Simulation & Combat Analysis Platform
flagship_applications.imageAlt: Two original dark metallic armored silhouettes mid-clash in an abstract spatial physics arena overlaid with electric cobalt trajectory vectors, impact rings, and Gaussian probability envelopes.
flagship_applications.imageLabel: Illustrative Simulation Concept — Original FDS Silhouettes
flagship_applications.relationshipToCinnabar: Forge BattleVerse is an independent application platform — NOT the name of the Cinnabar model family. BattleVerse is architected to integrate with Cinnabar Oracle text models for canonical extraction and evidence structuring while running deterministic physics calculations, claim auditing, and statistical simulation separately.

pillars.title: Canonical Version Tracking
pillars.detail: Separates distinct source continuities, timelines, and narrative eras so feats from incompatible versions are never conflated.

pillars.title: Evidence Validation & Claim Auditing
pillars.detail: Every asserted capability requires an explicit source reference, context check, and independent claim audit flagging outliers or hyperbolic statements.

pillars.title: Fictional Physics & Scaling Calculations
pillars.detail: Applies transparent mathematical assumptions, energy/kinematics bounds, and documented parameter ranges rather than opaque fan-consensus tiers.

pillars.title: Statistical Uncertainty & Multi-Format Simulation
pillars.detail: Models 1v1 and multi-character scenarios with explicit win-probability distributions, sensitivity bounds, and replay diagnostics — never presenting simulated outcomes as objective canonical fact.
